objects.st: Dragon Egg 1- 200 years ago, the dragons rose from the earth and a peasant, blessed with power, became queen.                                             Dragon Egg 2- 58 years ago, the dragons and their allies faced a civil war, and only the red dragon of fire survived.                                        Dragon Egg 3- With only one dragon remaining, the bond has weakened and the queens descendants magic has faded.                                             Dragon Egg 4- Worried that his power is not enough to rule, the king has walled himself in the castle, waiting for the bond to recover.                Dragon Egg 5- Meanwhile, the fire dragon slumbers in the volcano, drawing power from the rest of the land to heal from its battle wounds.  Dragon Egg 6- The King asks that you take the 6 dragon eggs you have collected to the volcano so that their power may wake.
